content.title: Air Show - The Air Dot Show Tour
content.text: Air Dot Show Tour Destination June 13-14, 2026 More Info We're soaring over seven iconic travel destinations in 2026! Plan a getaway to your favorite destination and experience the inspiration, power and patriotism of a Tour event! Air Dot Show Tour The 2026 Air Dot Show tour will visit seven iconic travel destinations. Plan a trip to your favorite destination and experience the inspiration, power and patriotism of a tour event! International Military Teams Air Dot Show hosts international military teams at Air Dot Show Tour destinations and works closely with them to coordinate flyovers of iconic national landmarks when they visit the USA. Military Open House Support The Air Dot Show Tour supports military base open houses nationwide assisting with marketing, sales and activation of premium viewing venues as well as advising on every aspect of organization Iconic Flyovers Air Dot Show works with the military, FAA, and other agencies to coordinate flights over some of the most iconic and historic landmarks in the nation. You can experience them on our YouTube Channel and social media channels. STEM Education Programs The National Air, Sea and Space Foundation hosts thousands of students on the AirDotShow Tour during rehearsal days where they learn about STEM based careers and opportunities in aviation and space The Cajun Scholarship The National Air, Sea and Space Foundation supports the next generation of aviators though programs like the Cajun Scholarship with a portion of the proceeds from the Air Dot Show Tour Air Dot Show on YouTube Go behind-the-scenes at all our destinations and virtually attend past tour events via our livestream broadcasts! Be sure to subscribe and click the bell for notifications on new videos! Where will we see you in 2026? An Air Dot Show Tour event is a great reason to plan a trip to one of our iconic travel destinations! Whether you love the big city, the beach, world class amusement parks, or golf, we have a destination for you to experience the power, precision and patriotism of an Air Dot Show Tour event! Air Dot Show Tour YouTube! If you can't make it to the show, we'll bring the show to you! Subscribe to our YouTube channel and get the latest highlights, in-cockpit views, and go behind the scenes at every Air Dot Show destination! Subscribe to our YouTube Channel then click the Bell to be notified about new videos from this year’s events and announcements for 2027!
